Configure, monitor, and maintain network equipment and firewalls, ensuring stable and secure office connectivity for 100+ users. Deploy and manage endpoint security solutions, implement patch management, and maintain firewall rules and VPN access in line with company cybersecurity policies. Maintain strong information security awareness and ensure IT operations comply with Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI), safeguarding staff and guest personal data. Administer CCTV and door access control systems, including user permissions, access reviews, and audit trails. Manage and maintain high-performance guest and staff Wi-Fi networks. Oversee data security for all software systems (PMS, POS, keycards, etc.) and support data backup and recovery. Manage IT assets, including inventory tracking and vendor coordination, and keep IT documentation up to date. Manage the procurement of computers and other IT equipment, from requirement gathering and specification selection to vendor sourcing, purchasing, and initial setup, in line with company standards and budget. Coordinate with the global IT team on cloud infrastructure, security incidents, and disaster recovery, escalating complex issues as needed. Collaborate with operations and other departments to identify and implement technology improvements that support business goals. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR 1-2 years of IT support or helpdesk experience Hands-on experience configuring network devices and firewalls, and managing a company network supporting 100+ users Solid troubleshooting skills across Windows and macOS operating systems and common business applications Good information security awareness, including endpoint protection, patch management, and firewall configuration Familiarity with CCTV and door access control systems and their permission management Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Active Directory/Entra ID, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) is a plus Fluent in both Japanese and English to communicate effectively with local vendors, staff, and the global team; proficiency in Chinese is a plus.
